newsitem.title: USA: Federal Express buying Argentina routes.
newsitem.headline: Federal Express buying Argentina routes.

text.p: Federal Express Corp said Tuesday it had reached agreement with Arrow Air Inc and Florida West International Airlines to purchase their all-cargo frequency allocations to Argentina.

"The additional frequencies give us the flexibility to further strengthen our global network," Joseph McCarty, Federal Express senior vice president for Latin America and the Caribbean, said in a statement.
FedEx is buying one weekly flight from Florida West and two from Arrow. Both carriers are privately-held all-cargo carriers based in Miami.
The transfer of the frequencies is subject to U.S. Department of Transportation approval, and approval by the boards of all three companies.
FedEx already flies once daily to and from Argentina. The agreement could add three flights per week.
